about: Feeding the zoo animals (Feeding Time!, user design 24 Nov 2026; docs/game/minigames.md#feeding-time). 'foods' are the five foods the zoo food booth sells (data/shops.json store 'zoo', each word's sold_in lists 'zoo'), in the order a bag offers them. 'eats' maps each zoo animal's word key to the foods it eats (the user's table; every animal eats at least one). 'food_phrases' names a phrase to say a food in a sentence when its word's display text cannot (fish: 'el pez (animal) / el pescado (comida)'). Read by scripts/world/animal_feeding.gd (free feeding with a bag) and scripts/learning/zoo_feeding_session.gd (the game; its levels pick animals by word tier, data/activities.json 'feeding_nico').
